description: Search BackPR's registration software pricing index: what dozens of registration, camp, childcare, class and sports platforms publish about plan prices, nonprofit offers, fees added for families and contract terms, each with the company's own wording and the date BackPR checked it. Filter by platform name, category or whether the platform is free for nonprofits. Use it to compare costs or find free options. BackPR publishes this index and sells registration software; BackPR isn't in the index.

free_for_nonprofits.description: true: only platforms whose published nonprofit offer is free. false: only platforms whose offer isn't free. Omit for all.

limit.description: How many platforms to return, 1 to 25 (default 10).

name.description: Platform name or part of it, such as "Jumbula" or "camp".

name: find_registration_software

comparison_page.description: BackPR's comparison page for this platform, with sources

fees_added_for_families.description: Fees added to what families pay

nonprofit_offer.description: Published nonprofit offer: free, discount, other or none published
